title: Insure workers for workers' compensation
what: Insure every worker under the state's workers' compensation scheme (or be a licensed self-insurer).

sources.title: Workers Compensation Act 1951 (ACT)
sources.quote: This section applies if an employer does not hold a compulsory insurance policy issued by a licensed insurer.

sources.title: Workers Compensation Act 1951 (ACT)
sources.quote: The regulator may give the employer a notice (a default notice) requiring the employer to obtain a compulsory insurance policy within 10 business days after the day the notice is given to the employer (the compliance period).

sources.title: Workers Compensation Act 1951 (ACT)
sources.quote: This section applies if an employer does not hold a compulsory insurance policy issued by a licensed insurer.

confidence_note: The ACT frames the duty through default notices (s 147) rather than a plain 'must insure'; the offence provisions are not yet quoted.
